analysis_plan: R1 fidelity -> R2 ceiling -> R3 CES + PP_CURVE -> R4 DEV selection then EVAL replay of NUE_X/NUE_LO -> R5 microbench + ranking equivalence -> R6 classify_phase1. Deterministic replays (no CI needed); kappa and transfer factor fixed by constants.
benchmark_gate: Paired A vs candidate (plus sham-equivalent control if the candidate has a no-op twin) palindromic blocks at 1.5 GiB; block count chosen prospectively from the projected net and the R3-04 DELTA_NET block sd so the 95% CI half-width <= projected net / 2; efficiency review > 60 min, separate authorization > 4 h; classification frozen before acquisition.
break_even_threshold: NET_PROJ_EVAL = 0 ms/token; the CURRENT design's derived envelope is in ECONOMIC_ENVELOPE.json

A.definition: b_selected(1.5 GiB) = aged_frequency decay 0.999 interval 1, frozen

BELADY.definition: Global Belady MIN over the same stream, same per-layer byte sizes, same budget, same atomic-event rule
BELADY.role: clairvoyant ceiling only (non-causal, never a candidate)

CES.definition: b_selected, plus: while serving an event at layer L, residents (L,e) with e in that event's served set are never chosen as victim (total fallback to unrestricted b_selected if no other candidate). Uses no predictor.

NUE_AMORT.definition: NUE_X with layer predictions refreshed every N same-layer events, N in {2,4,10}; held between refreshes.
NUE_AMORT.role: FALLBACK 2 (only if NUE_X fails the cost ratio)

NUE_LO.definition: NUE_X with the selected variant's key, but in_l = 1 iff e was in layer l's most recent observed event (last_observation; no transition state).

NUE_X.definition: CES, plus victim key for resident (l,e) = (in_l, aged_score, last_ref, layer, expert) ascending, where in_l = 1 if e is in layer l's current top_k decayed_transition (decay 0.99, top_k = frozen) prediction for layer l's NEXT event (computed after l's most recent event), else 0. Variants frozen for DEV selection: NUE_X_LEX (lexicographic as written), NUE_X_SOFT1 / NUE_X_SOFT4 (key = (aged_score + lambda*in_l, last_ref, layer, expert), lambda in {1,4}). Predictor realized as the exact incremental form for cost measurement.

PP_CURVE.definition: PP with prediction refreshed every N same-layer events, N in {1,2,4,10,20,50,100} (f = 1/N), held between refreshes

compute_budget.rule: any step projected > 60 min needs an explicit efficiency review; > 4 h needs separate prospective authorization

conformance_gate: Short traced real-model probe (<= 2 launches at 1.5 GiB): runtime decisions match offline replay event-for-event; decode miss counts match the R4 EVAL replay exactly; token digest unchanged.

constants.margin_justification: 10 ms/token is ~1.9% of A and ~1.9x the R3-04 18-block DELTA_NET 95% CI half-width (5.37 ms), so a FEASIBLE result is resolvable by a benchmark no larger than R3-04's primary; ratio >= 2 is applied AFTER halving kappa and a 4x microbench->runtime transfer (observed 3.65x), i.e. on top of already conservative conversions.

dev_eval_separation.fallback: if R2 DEV traces are unavailable: DEV = R3-04 stream decode tokens 0..255, EVAL = tokens 256..511 (policy state carried through, endpoints computed per half)
dev_eval_separation.primary: DEV = R2-09A DEV corpus traces (coding/instruction/reasoning/summarization, seed-42) at 1.5 GiB, read-only from the R2 evidence root, if present and hash-verifiable; EVAL = R3-04 decode stream
dev_eval_separation.rule: NUE_X variant chosen on DEV only (max bytes avoided); EVAL is scored once for the selected variant, NUE_LO, CES, PP, BELADY; no re-selection after EVAL

diagnosis_motivating_redesign: COST: PredictedProtectPolicy::predict_for_layer recomputes, per semantic event (48/token), a dense |current_set| x n_experts = 8 x 128 scan with one unordered_map probe and one std::pow per cell, then stable_sorts 128 ids, although only |prev| x |cur| = 64 transition cells change per event. Runtime incremental cost 464 us/event (483.4 vs 19.2); microbench predictor component 123.7 us/call.

VALUE: the protected set for layer L, computed after L's event at token t, is consulted during L's access at token t+1, i.e. it predicts the event CURRENTLY being served, whose true set is known. Its only possible effect is preventing intra-event self-eviction; it never informs cross-layer eviction, where the clairvoyant headroom lies.
CEILING: on the R2 coding-v1 trace at 1.5 GiB, Belady removes ~40% of b_selected misses; the current mechanism captures ~0.2% of that prior ceiling.

evidence_ladder.cost: <= 45 min CPU (3 x 5-10 GB streaming parse)
evidence_ladder.what: stream extraction + identity across 3 traces + replay fidelity (K0)
BELADY ceiling on the R3-04 stream at 1.5/4/8 GiB (K1)
NUE_X variants on DEV, selected NUE_X + NUE_LO on EVAL (K4, K5)
standalone C++ microbench: exact incremental predictor + NUE victim path vs b_selected; ranking equivalence
ONLY IF FEASIBLE: runtime realization + conformance probe (traced, short)

evidence_ladder.cost: efficiency review if > 60 min; separate prospective authorization if > 4 h
evidence_ladder.what: ONLY IF R7 passes: paired wall benchmark

failure_rule: R3_05_MARGINAL if the best candidate has 0 < NET_PROJ_EVAL < margin or ratio < 2 (no runtime campaign authorized; report only). R3_05_INFEASIBLE if no candidate has NET_PROJ_EVAL > 0.

families_evaluated.A_frequency_reduction: diagnostic PP_CURVE + fallback NUE_AMORT; cannot help PP because PP's value ceiling (0.57 ms) is below any realistic cost
families_evaluated.B_cheap_gate: deferred: gating a ~0 value decision cannot create value; revisit in R4 once a valuable decision exists
families_evaluated.C_phase_aware: secondary endpoint only (prefill vs decode); decode at fixed budget is homogeneous
families_evaluated.D_incremental: adopted as the cost realization of NUE_X (H3)
families_evaluated.F_economic_retention: adopted as the value mechanism of NUE_X (victim by predicted next use)
families_evaluated.G_high_cost_misses: secondary endpoint (byte-weighted); byte sizes vary only modestly by layer

frozen_data_allowed.R3_04_stream: R3-03A-conformance-run2 traces A-4GiB (sha256 154502dafdefede307f76169d830a268dc67c86ff1945e9f8fd0e6d38755b990), B-4GiB (677217ec...), C-8GiB; same output token digest ac28efbe... as R3-04; read-only, only (pass, layer, bytes_of_layer, requested_experts) extracted to an additive derived file
frozen_data_allowed.frozen_counters: Gate 2 MECHANISM_METRICS, R3-04 final evidence, R3-03B microbench (cost transfer)

hypotheses.H0_null: No causal candidate's projected net benefit (kappa_low benefit minus 4x-transferred microbench cost) reaches 10 ms/token on EVAL.
hypotheses.H1_misdirected_value: Most of predicted_protect's 0.09% miss-byte reduction is reproduced by a ZERO-COST exact current-event shield (CES).
hypotheses.H2_cross_layer_value: Using each resident's OWN layer's next-visit prediction to rank eviction victims (NUE) removes a materially larger fraction of b_selected misses than predicted_protect, approaching a non-trivial fraction of the clairvoyant headroom.
hypotheses.H3_cost_floor: An exact incremental reformulation of decayed_transition (scale-normalized dense rows, no pow on read, partial top-k) reduces incremental policy cost by >= 50x while preserving the predicted sets.
hypotheses.H4_no_amortization_needed: If H3 holds, invocation-frequency reduction is unnecessary; if H3 fails, amortization is only useful if benefit retained falls sub-linearly with refresh rate.

kill_rules.K0_FIDELITY: offline replay must reproduce the Gate 2 1.5 GiB decode counters of A and PP integer-exactly; otherwise Phase 1 is INVALID and nothing is interpreted
kill_rules.K1_CEILING: if BELADY bytes avoided x kappa_low < 10 ms/token on the R3-04 stream: stop predictive retention as the primary R3 path (no causal policy can pay with margin)
kill_rules.K2_PP_RETIRED: if CES >= 80% of PP's bytes avoided: predicted_protect is retired permanently (its value was not predictive)
kill_rules.K3_NO_AMORTIZATION: if PP_CURVE keeps <= 20% of PP benefit at f = 0.10: the invocation-reduction family is dropped
kill_rules.K4_BENEFIT_FLOOR: if a candidate's benefit at ZERO cost (kappa_low x bytes avoided) < 10 ms/token it is INFEASIBLE regardless of any cost optimization; no cost engineering is done for it
kill_rules.K5_PREFER_SURROGATE: if NUE_LO net >= 80% of NUE_X net: NUE_LO becomes the R3-05 candidate (prefer the cheaper baseline)

new_data_required: None model-bearing for the Phase 1 decision. New derived artifacts: extracted stream, replay results, one standalone C++ microbenchmark of the candidate decision path (new file in this directory; runtime sources untouched).
primary_endpoint: NET_PROJ_EVAL(c) at 1.5 GiB = kappa_low * (A minus c decode miss bytes per token on the EVAL stream) - transfer_factor * (c minus b_selected microbench ns/event) * events_per_token; ms/token; positive = c faster than A.
r3_r4_boundary: R3-05 tests ONE fixed causal retention rule (NUE_X, or its surrogate) with no runtime switching, no regime detection and no learned controller. Gating, policy portfolios and adaptive controllers (families B and H) are reserved for R4 and are only described, never evaluated, here.
research_question: What is the minimum decision cost required to capture a useful fraction of future-retention value at 1.5 GiB, and does any causal predictive retention decision exist whose projected value exceeds its projected cost by the pre-registered margin? If none exists even at zero decision cost, per-token predictive retention is declared uneconomic in the tested regime.
runtime_realization_gate: Before any model launch: the candidate is implemented additively in the retention-policy module behind a new policy id; C++ vs Python bit-identical decisions on the extracted R3-04 stream (offline conformance harness); A/PP/sham semantics unchanged; separate human approval.
secondary_endpoints: decode misses and miss bytes per token vs A, CES, PP, BELADY at 1.5 / 4 / 8 GiB
PP_CURVE retained-benefit fraction at each f
byte-weighted vs count-weighted miss reduction (miss-cost heterogeneity, family G)
prefill vs decode split of the effect (family C)
ranking equivalence of the incremental predictor vs the frozen reference (event-level top_k set agreement)
success_rule: R3_05_FEASIBLE iff replay fidelity gate passes AND the DEV-selected candidate has dev and eval miss-byte reductions > 0 AND NET_PROJ_EVAL >= 10 ms/token AND benefit_low / cost_high >= 2. Executable: phase0.classify_phase1.
title: R3-05 Economic predictive retention: is there a decision whose value exceeds its cost?
